## CO₂ Absorption Calculator v2.0.0 — first release

A complete rebuild of the ISEL final-year project (originally a Windows Tkinter app for Oeiras, Portugal) as a web app that works for **any region up to 1 000 km²**.

### Highlights

- **Any region**: draw a polygon or rectangle, search a place (OpenStreetMap boundaries) or upload a GeoJSON / zipped shapefile
- **Satellite processing in the background**: cloud-masked Sentinel-2 composites (Copernicus openEO), ESA WorldCover 2021 land cover and NASA POWER climate data, with live progress
- **CASA model**: NPP = 0.5 · SOL · FPAR · T1 · T2 · WSC · Emax, converted to CO₂ (× 44/12)
- **Results dashboard**: CO₂ absorbed, emissions offset, productivity per hectare, totals by land cover and a month-by-month chart
- **Interactive atlas**: CO₂, NPP, NDVI, FPAR, water stress, light-use efficiency and land-cover layers
- **Exports**: PDF report (PT/EN), CSV table, GeoTIFF layers
- **Portuguese & English** interface
- **Settings page** to store Copernicus credentials server-side (write-only)
- **Optional demo password** protecting write actions
- **Validated** against the thesis: Oeiras, June 2024 → 20 384 t CO₂ vs 20 228 t (< 1 % difference)

### Run it

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tibi-tech/co2-absorption-calculator:2.0.0
docker run -p 8000:8000 -v co2-data:/data ghcr.io/tibi-tech/co2-absorption-calculator:2.0.0
```

Then open http://localhost:8000. Or use `docker compose up` from the repository. See the [README](https://github.com/tibi-tech/CO2-Absorption-Calculator#getting-started) for configuration and Copernicus credentials.

### Other changes

- FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, SQLite storage, Docker image and CI
- Legacy `ANEXOS/`, `Código/` and `Resultados/` folders removed; reports and posters moved to `docs/`
- Thesis reference data kept as test fixtures

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tibi-tech/CO2-Absorption-Calculator/commits/v2.0.0
